name: Hyperparameters and reproduction
title: Hyperparameters and reproduction: what a method section owes you
blurb: A method section is a recipe, and a recipe you cannot cook from is not a recipe. This section separates the three things people mean by "reproduction", lists the items an independent implementer needs before their result is even determined, and shows how to read a hyperparameter table as a description of the model rather than a report of a result. It is the vocabulary for judging what a paper's own tables do and do not let a reader rebuild.
skip_hint: If you can say which parts of a pipeline a method section must pin down before an independent implementation is fully determined, skip this section.
